label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: Y ahora, alza ahora mi pecado solo esta vez, e intercedan a Jehová su Dios, y quite de sobre mí solo esta muerte.
spanish: Y ahora, alza, por favor, mi pecado solo esta vez, e intercedan a Jehová su Dios, y quite de sobre mí solo esta muerte.
grammarChanges: Replaced the duplicated temporal 'ahora' (which had absorbed the entreaty particle נָא) with the politeness marker 'por favor', since the temporal sense of 'now' is already carried by the opening 'Y ahora' (וְעַתָּה); this restores the entreaty force of נָא without adding a second 'now'.
